selection_rule: Assign every case with at least one existing v1 claim to v1 permanently; continuation is the ordered complement within the frozen 1004 failures. Claim presence only, never outcomes, selects the partition.

pilot_development.rule: Pilot outcomes are development-only and never merged as primary outcomes. All four IDs remain in exactly one primary partition based only on v1 claim presence.

aggregation_contract.raw_selected_warning: v1 manifest selects all 1004, even though only its claimed case partition belongs to the joint analysis. Do not concatenate raw selected=true rows.
aggregation_contract.effective_selection: For each frozen case ID, use only its assigned source partition; require that source row raw selected=true. Preserve source and raw_selected alongside effective_selected=true in the union. Ignore other-run rows for that ID, regardless of outcome.
aggregation_contract.missing_expected_source: Retain the ID as classification=unknown with explicit missing source/row/selected reason; never fall back to pilot, another run, another arm attempt, or a later best outcome.
aggregation_contract.first_attempt_rule: Any v1 claimed case, including a single-arm claim or missing/unknown/failed result, remains v1. No repeated primary attempt on continuation.
verification: Verify frozen 1004 manifest and this selection receipt hash.
Verify v1 config/manifest/claim hashes against source_evidence; verify continuation config pinned SHA and its manifest SHA plus exact remaining_jobs membership.
Verify classification schema, fixed denominator, unique case IDs, source selected membership and four allowed labels.
Project source rows through case_partition; assert exactly 1004 unique IDs and sum of four categories equals 1004.

metrics.strict_R_over_1004: Count only strict source classification rescued, divided by 1004; retain unknown/unexecuted/deviations.
metrics.matched_complete_pair_M: Both source arm_status entries have valid_completed=true, no initial deviation, and preintervention prefix.exact=true.
metrics.strict_R_over_M: R/M for M>0, otherwise null; explicitly conditional and not a benchmark score.
metrics.raw_pairs: Separately count both valid-completed arms with boolean outcomes: both_success, control_only, astra_only, both_failure. Raw astra_only is not strict rescue.

aggregation_contract.stratification: Recompute counts per frozen stratum and task using the union, never sum fixed_1004 per-run summaries.
aggregation_contract.publication_boundary: No new official 2500-episode score; do not report (1496+R)/2500 as a fresh evaluation. Tokens/cost require separate evidence aggregation.
